subject: Hosted API pricing & traffic snapshot — EmberTech follow-up
messages:
From: Ari Bennett <ari@embertech.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.inference>
Cc: Susan Park <susan@embertech.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: EmberTech -> Redwood: post-demo traffic snapshot + pricing ask

Hi Mina —

Thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick follow-up from our side: the team requested a short traffic profile so your pricing folks can give us a hosted API estimate. I attached a CSV with our short sample (hourly for a week) and a one-pager on our SLA asks.

High-level asks:
- Hosted API estimate for our expected monthly token volume (see attached), plus an idea of unit price per 1M tokens.
- Peak traffic guidance: we want to know the peak TPS (requests/sec) you’d plan for based on the attached profile and any recommendations for smoothing/bursting.

A few quick notes from product: average prompt size ~320 tokens, average completion ~750 tokens; most calls are single-turn chat. Expected active users at launch ~25k, ramping to 80k over 3 months.

Budget: we’re planning a $10k–$30k monthly acquisition/ops budget for inference initially — open to suggestions on how that maps to token tiers.

Attached: ember_traffic_profile_oct.csv (sample), ember_sla_requests.pdf

Appreciate a short recap & suggested next steps.

—Ari
Ari Bennett
Head of Product, EmberTech
ari@embertech.ai
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.inference>
To: Ari Bennett <ari@embertech.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EmberTech -> Redwood: post-demo traffic snapshot + pricing ask

Hi Ari —

Thanks for sending the sample and context — good signal. I pulled the CSV and sketched a quick traffic summary below to make sure we’re aligned before Ben/Karthik run numbers:

Quick interpretation (from sample):
- Weekly baseline (extrapolated): ~60M tokens/month (range 45M–85M based on weekday/weekend swings).
- Average tokens per request (prompt + completion): ~1,070 tokens.
- Peak observed request rate in sample: ~110 req/s (sustained short windows), we typically plan for +30–50% headroom; that would imply planning for ~150–165 req/s.

Questions to confirm pricing math:
1) What’s your expected month-1 monthly run-rate (low/most-likely/high)?
2) Are there predictable daily peaks (e.g., 3 hours/day) or many short bursts from campaigns?
3) Any requirement for deterministic latency SLAs (<200ms vs <500ms) — this changes host vs dedicated recommendations.

Ben/Karthik — can you validate the above interpretation and propose: (a) hosted API unit price bands for 1M tokens, (b) recommended headroom / burst policy for this profile, and (c) any cost-saving levers (quantization, caching) if they need to keep spend inside $10k–$30k/month?

Next steps: 1) I’ll sync with you (Ari) after Ben/Karthik share the draft bands, 2) we can propose a pilot commit or trial credit to validate peaks.

—Mina
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-10-18T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: FW: EmberTech -> Redwood: post-demo traffic snapshot + pricing ask

Internal notes / quick calc (rough):

Using Mina’s baseline ~60M tokens/month and avg tokens/request ~1,070 -> ~56k requests/month (60M / 1,070).
If they hit 85M -> ~79k requests/month.

Peak sizing: Mina’s observed peak 110 req/s; recommend planning for 175 req/s peak request rate (we usually size +50% for headroom) which at 1,070 tokens/request -> ~187k tokens/sec peak.

Pricing bands (hosted API) — draft suggestions to present:
- Band A (standard): $20 / 1M tokens — No commit, metered.
- Band B (commit 3mo): $15 / 1M tokens — 3-month commit; includes limited burst protection.
- Band C (reserved/dedicated discussion): $10–12 / 1M tokens — requires committed capacity; better tail latencies and higher burst capacity.

Cost impact for 60M tokens:
- $20/1M -> $1,200
- $15/1M -> $900
- $12/1M -> $720

Notes: these are example unit rates for conversational models (sst/4-class). For heavy latency SLAs or embeddings-heavy workflows prices vary. Also recommend suggesting token reduction levers: short prompts, stop tokens, response truncation, or output sampling.

Karthik — can you sanity-check the headroom math and add any recommendations on autoscale burst policy for hosted customers (how long we allow 3x burst before fallback)?

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.inference
From: Ari Bennett <ari@embertech.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.inference>
Cc: Susan Park <susan@embertech.ai>, billing@embertech.ai
Date: 2026-10-19T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EmberTech -> Redwood: post-demo traffic snapshot + pricing ask

Thanks Mina / Ben — this is helpful. A couple follow-ups / clarifications from the product team:

1) Month-1 ramp expectation: low 30M, likely 70M, high 120M tokens/month.
2) Peaks: we’ll have two daily campaign-driven spikes (approx 20–30 minutes) where request rate jumps ~3x from baseline. The rest of the day is steady.
3) Latency: for user-facing flows we’d like 95th percentile <400ms where possible; willing to pay a premium for this on core endpoints.

Budget: $10k–$30k is still the ballpark. If the unit economics line up near $12–$15 /1M tokens we should be able to structure a 3-month pilot commit.

Additional data: average tokens/request updated -> prompt 340, completion 720 -> ~1,060 tokens/request.

Could you provide:
- A hosted API quote for 70M tokens/month with a burst policy that accommodates 3x short spikes (20–30 minutes twice/day) and a suggested unit price for pilot (3-month trial).
- Any recommended controls to keep spend predictable during spikes (hard caps, circuit-breaker, graceful fallback).

Appreciate if you can push a short proposal by EOD tomorrow — we want to get internal buy-in.

—Ari
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.inference>
To: Ari Bennett <ari@embertech.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-10-20T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EmberTech -> Redwood: post-demo traffic snapshot + pricing ask

Ari — appreciate the quick clarity. Summary & proposed next steps below (short bullet-ready for your execs):

Summary (aligned numbers):
- Most-likely monthly tokens: 70M (range 30M–120M).
- Avg tokens/request: ~1,060.
- Baseline peak request rate: ~110 req/s; plan for peak headroom ~165–175 req/s.
- Campaign spikes: ~3x baseline for 20–30 minutes, twice/day — recommend a short-burst policy to cover these.

Pilot proposal (3-month):
- Offer: Hosted API pilot for 70M tokens/month at $14 / 1M tokens (pilot price).
- Burst handling: allow 3x burst for up to 30 minutes, auto-fallback to a low-cost model variant if sustained >30 minutes.
- Controls: provide token-budget alerts, hard monthly cap option, and request-level circuit-breaker to avoid runaway costs.
- SLA: 95th percentile latency target <400ms on pilot for core endpoints; we’ll include an operational playbook for incident response.

Next steps:
1) If you’re comfortable, I’ll convert this into a one-page SOW and a HubSpot proposal (EMB-2026-0917).
2) Ben will follow up with a short ops note on burst policies and autoscale knobs.
3) We can propose $5k pilot credits to accelerate the first month of testing if you sign the pilot SOW.

If that all looks good I’ll get the one-pager over today.

—Mina
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.inference

Attachment stubs: ember_pricing_sketch.pdf (draft), pilot_sow_template.docx
